description: Auto-match a deck's wants against the collection: free copies become non-shared staged allocations (real cards preferred over proxies). allow_shared:true additionally covers remaining needs with copies already allocated to OTHER decks, as explicitly shared allocations. Returns claimed / shared / missing. ALWAYS relay the shared list (with the other decks) and the missing list to the user. Every proxy it claims, owned or borrowed, is named in proxies_claimed (each claimed and shared entry carries is_proxy); proxy_warning, when not null, is one sentence: relay it to the user word for word. Claiming moves no real card: once the user has physically built the deck, sleeve_deck moves the claimed cards into it. On a tournament deck (deck.play) only real copies are claimed. They fill empty slots first, and each one past them releases one of the card's proxies (proxies_replaced, released: relay them). A released proxy that was sleeved is recorded back in "Unsorted": tell the user to take it out of the deck box and sleeve the real copy. This powers the "import deck → pull what I have → tell me what I lack" workflow.
name: claim_from_collection
title: Claim from collection
